title: Live-Service Uplift for Late Recovery Review Goodwill
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the customer's Web Hosting Plans and Domain Registrations holdings.

## Rule

The live-service uplift of the late-review goodwill follows the products the customer could not manage while locked out: where the customer holds an active hosting plan, the uplift is $4.00; where the customer holds no active hosting plan but holds an active domain, the uplift is $2.00; otherwise no uplift is added. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-review goodwill figure.

## Decision table

| Active hosting plan held | Active domain held | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | $4.00 |
| yes | no | $4.00 |
| no | yes | $2.00 |
| no | no | nothing |

The two amounts never combine: holding both an active plan and an active domain adds $4.00.
